name: auth-page
title: Auth Page
description: A sign-in or sign-up page, the app's form in it. Wide (48rem and up, by its own width): two halves, the app's aside on the muted grey at the start (the brand at the top, its title, h2, and words at the foot) and the form on the page's colour at the end, its title (h1, text-display) and description over it, switchTo (e.g. a link to sign up) at the top's end on the brand's line, terms at the foot. Narrow: the form on a card on the grey, the brand and switchTo above it, the terms under it; the aside only with asideOnNarrow. The app puts in its form and its words, no styles of its own. With titlebar, in a desktop window whose own buttons are over the page, a bar across its top as high as the window's title bar (env(titlebar-area-height), else --agent-app-titlebar-height on the root, else 40px) drags the window as an AgentApp titlebar does, the page 8px under it. Wide or narrow by its own width, measured (data-wide, group-data-wide/auth: for the app's), not a container query, so no size container wraps the form's own.
